About.title: A Life in Public Service
About.subtitle: Decades of dedicated public service to the people of Karnataka.
About.bio1: R. Roshan Baig is a veteran Indian politician who served as a seven-time Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) for the Shivajinagar constituency in Bengaluru, Karnataka. He entered public life with a deep commitment to social welfare.
About.bio2: Throughout his distinguished career, he has held key portfolios in the Karnataka state government, serving as the Minister of Home Affairs, Minister for Urban Development, Infrastructure & Haj, and Minister for Tourism. His focus has consistently been on community empowerment and state infrastructure.
About.quote: Leadership is not about the position you hold, but the positive impact you create in the lives of the people.
